test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 13 Feb 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: The population of a village during the first year increases by 5% and during the second year it diminishes by 5%. At the end of the second year its population was 9975. What was the population at the beginning of the first year?
solution:
**Given:**

Population at the end of the second year = 9975

Increase in the first year = 5%

Decrease in the second year = 5%

**Concept:** 

Population at the beginning of the first year = Population at the end of the second year/([(100 + Increase%)/100] × [(100 - Decrease%)/100])

**Solution:**

⇒ Population at the beginning of the first year = 9975/([(100 + 5)/100] × [(100 - 5)/100])

⇒ 9975 × 100/105 × 100/95 = 10000

**Hence, the population at the beginning of the first year was 10,000.**
